minimal_form: S_parent=sum S_i with field list and dimensions
acceptance_rule: must include all retained sectors or explicitly demote omitted sectors

minimal_form: delta S_i=E_i delta Phi_i+d theta_i for each sector
acceptance_rule: must name theta_i, stress/source terms and boundary terms
must not use EH charge as full MTS charge

minimal_form: S_GK or retained q_loc residual with Helmholtz/Euler/double-zero status
acceptance_rule: must close or explicitly bound the hard local sector

minimal_form: parent source worldtube, same-frame J_H, Pi_M map and fixed linking surfaces
acceptance_rule: must not use orbital GM or fitted masks

minimal_form: H_ref/B_ref fixed before readout with no cancellation tuning
acceptance_rule: must include source path/equation ref and improvement convention
